note: All rates are integer KOBO (1 NGN = 100 kobo) per PRD §5.1 — display via formatNaira() from @eas/types, never floats. netRateKoboPerKg = grossRateKoboPerKg less the platform fee percent. E-waste is priced per item, negotiated at drop-off.

materials.name: PET bottles (clear, baled)
materials.description: Clear PET water and soda bottles, caps removed, baled or loose.

materials.name: Aluminum cans
materials.description: Aluminum drink cans (Coca-Cola, Pepsi, malt drinks). Crushed preferred.

materials.name: HDPE (milk jugs, shampoo)
materials.description: High-density polyethylene: milk jugs, shampoo bottles, detergent containers.

materials.name: Nylon / sachet water bags
materials.description: Pure water sachets, shopping nylons. Must be clean and dry.

materials.name: Clean paper / cartons
materials.description: Cardboard cartons, newspapers, office paper. No grease, no water damage.

materials.name: Mixed plastics (low grade)
materials.description: Mixed low-grade plastics: toys, broken buckets, PVC scraps.

materials.name: E-waste (per item, manual)
materials.description: Scrap phones, chargers, small appliances. Price negotiated per item at drop-off.
